text: Borax casein is the artists' route: pH neutral and longer-lasting than lime casein.

links.name: Natural Earth Paint, casein paint recipe

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Borax, 1 tablespoon for each part of casein powder, is mixed into 8 tablespoons of hot water per batch.
The mixture is heated, but must not get hotter than about 82 °C.
